Subject: POC / Trial Planning - Success Criteria & Timeline (Acme Industries)

Hi Sam / Liam 

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kickoff the POC: 

Summary of outcomes from our discovery:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Acme
's customer support summarization pipeline (short-form replies + routing).
- Primary success criteria (what Acme wants to measure):
  - Accuracy: summaries match internal QA rubric >= 85% on the seeded test set
  - Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 250ms for 512-token requests
  - Cost target: inference cost <= $0.015 / 1k tokens
  - Reliability: no more than 2% error rate during peak traffic profile

Proposed POC scope & evaluation plan:
1) Data & test sets: Acme provides a 500-1,000 message seeded test set and representative traffic profile.
2) Environment: Redwood Dedicated dev pool + prefix caching enabled; we'll provide a sandbox API key scoped to the trial.
3) Metrics & dashboards: we'll surface token-level cost, latency percentiles, and per-prompt accuracy on a shared Drive dashboard.
4) Timeline (proposal):
  - Kickoff & environment setup: week of Feb 22 (1 week)
  - Ingest & baseline run: Feb 28- Mar 4
  - Iteration/tuning: Mar 7- Mar 18 (2 weeks)
  - Final readout & decision: week of Mar 21 (final report + recommendations)

Owners (suggested):
- Acme PM / decision maker: Sam Torres
- Redwood SE lead: Rishi Malhotra (cc'd) - responsible for model selection, infra setup, and weekly check-ins
- Redwood infra eng: Dev Patel (cc'd) - responsible for environment provisioning and access

Next steps I can action this week:
- Share POC plan (attached) and preliminary QA checklist for review
- Create calendar invites for kickoff + weekly 30-min check-ins
- Send sandbox credentials and a short onboarding note for your engineering team

Can you confirm the proposed timeline and whether the seeded test set is available by Feb 25? If dates look off, suggest alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Best,
